What services does Krynova Technologies offer?

How much does custom software development cost?

Costs vary based on requirements. We offer flexible pricing starting from affordable packages for small businesses to enterprise-level solutions.

Yes! We provide 24/7 support and maintenance for all our products with dedicated account managers.

How long does it take to develop a custom solution?
